# json-to-express v0.2.0-beta.2

Token-free npm publishing verification release, building on the fully tested v0.2.0-beta.1 generator.

## Changes
- npm beta release automation now uses npm Trusted Publishing via GitHub Actions OIDC, without long-lived npm tokens.
- The workflow requires successful main-branch CI, `id-token: write`, and explicitly enabled trusted publishing.
- Keeps signed provenance support, reviewed npm tarball smoke tests and all 16 generated-app CI jobs.
- No functional changes to generator behavior relative to v0.2.0-beta.1.

## Usage

```bash
npm install -g json-to-express@beta
j2e --version
```

Requires Node.js >=18. Prerelease behavior is subject to change before 1.0.0.
